context.stage: BO initiative origination for full development workflow

task.description: Submit a SwiftRoute BO feature initiative in business language for a fully complete tenant registration process including tenant object visibility, OIDC authority readiness, and guaranteed tenant schema table materialization before completion.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative clearly states expected end-to-end behavior
Result status is PASS or FAIL with issues
next_action explicitly requests routing to WF-01 (REQ-ANALYST)

result.summary: Alice Bauer and Marco Stein request a complete tenant onboarding flow where operations can register a new tenant once, immediately see that tenant in dispatch-facing lists, and start work only after identity authority and tenant data tables are fully ready.

business_initiative.initiative_title: SwiftRoute tenant registration and go-live readiness
business_initiative.expected_end_to_end_behavior: A dispatcher or operations manager registers a tenant, the tenant record is visible right away in operational views, login authority for that tenant is ready without manual fixes, and onboarding only completes when the tenant schema tables are fully created so dispatch and incident work can begin safely.
measurable_acceptance_criteria: Tenant registration completes with a confirmed tenant ID and no manual repair step.
The newly registered tenant is visible in tenant object listings used by operations immediately after registration.
Tenant-specific sign-in authority is active and accepts valid credentials as part of onboarding readiness.
Onboarding cannot be marked complete until required tenant schema tables are materialized and verified.
If identity authority or schema setup fails, onboarding returns a clear business failure and does not expose the tenant as ready for dispatch operations.
